answer: The lagoon credits a ferrous hull by the attested river tenure of its least-tenured identity, not by their sum. Each further identity on that hull must arrive with one more flood of judged river work than the last, or the hull's credit drops. Ten identities cost 55 attested floods; a first identity costs one. A replacement keel may be forged once from the old ferrous keel and inherits the least tenure, so a fresh hull cannot reset the ladder.
